name: closeout-metadata-review-retention
title: Prevent closeout metadata from invalidating reviewer receipts
description: Fix the lifecycle closeout ordering and canonical-writer retention gaps observed in B-3aec. Trusted command-generated validation, DONE-required, live-smoke, summary, delivery-check, and done_prepare artifacts must not force repeated metadata-only DEV/REVIEW rounds. Align delivery dispatch and write phases, and stop concept preflight from treating function-body edits as deleted symbols.
